title: Bronze, Silver and Gold contracts
summary: Use medallion layers as data-quality contracts, not as mandatory folder names.

blocks.text: Use medallion layers as data-quality contracts, not as mandatory folder names.

items: Bronze preserves source fidelity and ingestion metadata.
Silver applies validated, conformed and deduplicated logic.
Gold serves stable business-ready aggregates/data products.
A small project may not need every layer; avoid copying data without adding a clear contract.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
